context: Asuka and Riku tour a uniquely built old house.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: architecture visit; vocabulary (独自/組み合わせ/少々/建て/肩) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: この家、独自の形ですね。
lines.en: This house has a unique shape.
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、独自の方法で建てられました。
lines.en: Yes, it was built with a unique method.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 木と石の組み合わせが、面白いです。
lines.en: The combination of wood and stone is interesting.
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その組み合わせが、独自の魅力です。
lines.en: That combination is its unique charm.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: The ceiling is a little low.
lines.style: observant teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 少々かがむと、肩がぶつかりますよ。
lines.en: If you stoop a little, your shoulder bumps it.
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昔の人は、独自に工夫したんですね。
lines.en: People long ago devised things uniquely.
lines.style: reflective teen boy voice, soft warm wonder throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 木と土の組み合わせで、建てたんですよ。
lines.en: They built it combining wood and earth.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
